purpose: Teach: キロメートル/秒間/車掌/電柱/ノース/サウス/サッシ/リール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、配送センターから半径五キロメートルを商圏とせよ
lines.en: Define our service area as a five-kilometre radius from the distribution centre.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured cadence. Each phrase lands with certainty. No softening, no repeat. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。受発注の処理時間を秒間単位で計測します
lines.en: Understood. We'll start measuring order processing times in second-by-second intervals.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation, almost note-to-self. Slight pause after 'Understood' as he mentally notes the instruction. Steady, no question mark in his voice. Professional compliance without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員旅行の電車に車掌経験者を同乗させろ
lines.en: Assign a conductor with railway experience to accompany the company trip.
lines.style: Same clipped authority as the first line. Slight emphasis on 'conductor' — this detail matters to him. Cold precision. He's solving problems before they happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業所近くの電柱の広告を更新します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange for the advertisements near our branch office to be refreshed.
lines.style: Brief, professional acknowledgment. No hesitation. Treating each directive as a separate, actionable item. Quiet competence. The tone of someone who writes things down and ticks them off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、北米支社、つまりノース支社の展開を進めろ
lines.en: Push forward with our North American expansion — the North branch development.
lines.style: Steady authority. A slight reformulation on 'North' — clarifying even as he commands. Not condescending, but precise. The pace is unhurried because the instruction itself is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。南米支社、つまりサウス拠点の調査を始めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll begin surveying the South American operations — our Southern base.
lines.style: Mirroring his clarification with a quiet parallel structure. Accepting the instruction as logical. No strain in his voice. The professionalism of someone who understands the symmetry of what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本社ビルのサッシ交換を計画しろ
lines.en: Plan the window and frame replacement project for the head office building.
lines.style: Authoritative, concrete. Slight emphasis on 'plan' — this is the directive. Unhurried. The tone of someone who knows exactly what needs doing and trusts his subordinate to execute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告撮影のリール素材を制作します
lines.en: Understood. I'll begin producing reel footage for the advertising shoot.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment, slightly lighter in weight than the others. A soft close to the sequence. Professional but not labored. The tone of someone finishing his notes and preparing to move forward.
